children: Gupta moves to Honasa after a year-long stint at Lenskart, following her earlier role at HealthKart
Honasa Consumer has appointed Neha Gupta as Senior Vice President. She shared teh news on her LinkedIn post.
“I’m happy to share that I’m starting a new position as Senior Vice President at Honasa Consumer!,” she wrote in the post.
Gupta took up the new role in August, joining Honasa Consumer from Lenskart, where she served as Head of Marketing – India for a year.
Prior to Lenskart, Gupta was associated with HealthKart.
